text: Friday evening, in another city, a stranger puts a new SIM card into a new phone.
prefix: Friday evening, in another city, a stranger puts a new SIM card into a new phone.

text: This afternoon, the mobile operator gave him Aziz's number.
prefix: This afternoon, the mobile operator gave him Aziz's number.

text: He installs the mobile bank and taps Forgot password.
prefix: He installs the mobile bank and taps Forgot password.

text: Every SMS to Aziz's number now arrives on his phone.
prefix: Every SMS to Aziz's number now arrives on his phone.

text: Is that enough to take the account?
prefix: Is that enough to take the account?

text: In Lesson 29, a password change ended every session of the same or a lower rank.
prefix: In Lesson 29, a password change ended every session of the same or a lower rank.

text: This lesson opens the other door to a new password: the reset, when the person has no session at all.
prefix: This lesson opens the other door to a new password: the reset, when the person has no session at all.

text: A reset in the master app starts with the phone number.
prefix: A reset in the master app starts with the phone number.

text: Then the platform runs the checks of a login from that phone, without the password.
prefix: Then the platform runs the checks of a login from that phone, without the password.

text: On a known phone, that is a one-time code through TAF.
prefix: On a known phone, that is a one-time code through TAF.

text: On a new phone, it is the new-device code through TAF, and then the account check.
prefix: On a new phone, it is the new-device code through TAF, and then the account check.

text: Watch the stranger.
prefix: Watch the stranger.

text: The TAF code arrives on his phone, because the SIM card really has Aziz's number.
prefix: The TAF code arrives on his phone, because the SIM card really has Aziz's number.

text: The verdict can even be green.
prefix: The verdict can even be green.

text: But Aziz was at level two, so the account check asks for MyID on this new phone.
prefix: But Aziz was at level two, so the account check asks for MyID on this new phone.

text: The stranger's face is not Aziz's face, and the reset stops.
prefix: The stranger's face is not Aziz's face, and the reset stops.

text: MyID protects Aziz.
prefix: MyID protects Aziz.

text: But what about a customer who was never at level two?
prefix: But what about a customer who was never at level two?

text: There is no face on file to compare.
prefix: There is no face on file to compare.

text: For that customer, a second guard does the work: time.
prefix: For that customer, a second guard does the work: time.

text: When the person still has an active session somewhere, the reset does not change the password at once.
prefix: When the person still has an active session somewhere, the reset does not change the password at once.

text: It waits for the configured waiting period.
prefix: It waits for the configured waiting period.

text: The platform answers with the time when the reset will end.
prefix: The platform answers with the time when the reset will end.

text: And it sends a notification, password reset requested, by push to every session and by SMS.
prefix: And it sends a notification, password reset requested, by push to every session and by SMS.

text: The real owner sees it on the phone in his pocket.
prefix: The real owner sees it on the phone in his pocket.

text: Now only two parties can cancel the waiting reset.
prefix: Now only two parties can cancel the waiting reset.

text: One is a session of rank two: a master-app session with a green TAF check.
prefix: One is a session of rank two: a master-app session with a green TAF check.

text: The other is a bank operator, with a reason.
prefix: The other is a bank operator, with a reason.

text: A session of rank one gets the notification, but no cancel button.
prefix: A session of rank one gets the notification, but no cancel button.

text: Why so strict?
prefix: Why so strict?

text: A cancel keeps the old password alive, so only the strongest check may do it.
prefix: A cancel keeps the old password alive, so only the strongest check may do it.

text: When the owner taps Cancel, the old password stays valid, and a notification says that the reset was cancelled.
prefix: When the owner taps Cancel, the old password stays valid, and a notification says that the reset was cancelled.

text: When nobody cancels, the waiting period ends.
prefix: When nobody cancels, the waiting period ends.

text: The new password becomes valid, and the phone gets a session.
prefix: The new password becomes valid, and the phone gets a session.

text: Every other session of the same or a lower rank ends, and the probation period starts.
prefix: Every other session of the same or a lower rank ends, and the probation period starts.

text: Then the notification: password changed.
prefix: Then the notification: password changed.

text: I think this waiting reset is the most important rule against a SIM swap.
prefix: I think this waiting reset is the most important rule against a SIM swap.

text: An SMS code alone must never take an account from a person who is still using it.
prefix: An SMS code alone must never take an account from a person who is still using it.

text: Now the honest case.
prefix: Now the honest case.

text: On Sunday, Aziz himself forgets his password, on his own trusted phone.
prefix: On Sunday, Aziz himself forgets his password, on his own trusted phone.

text: The mobile bank sends a code through TAF, and the verdict is green.
prefix: The mobile bank sends a code through TAF, and the verdict is green.

text: Then the mobile bank offers him a MyID check, right inside the reset.
prefix: Then the mobile bank offers him a MyID check, right inside the reset.

text: He passes the re-check.
prefix: He passes the re-check.

text: With a green verdict and MyID on this phone, the reset does not wait.
prefix: With a green verdict and MyID on this phone, the reset does not wait.

text: Aziz types a new password, and types it a second time.
prefix: Aziz types a new password, and types it a second time.

text: That is the deal the master app offers.
prefix: That is the deal the master app offers.

text: Prove the SIM with TAF, and prove the face with MyID, and you skip the wait.
prefix: Prove the SIM with TAF, and prove the face with MyID, and you skip the wait.

text: A customer who was never at level two can do the same, with a full MyID check and consent.
prefix: A customer who was never at level two can do the same, with a full MyID check and consent.

text: Without MyID, the reset waits.
prefix: Without MyID, the reset waits.

text: And when the person has no active session at all, there is nobody to warn, so the reset does not wait either.
prefix: And when the person has no active session at all, there is nobody to warn, so the reset does not wait either.

text: Now the side apps.
prefix: Now the side apps.

text: They have no TAF and no MyID, so their reset is weaker.
prefix: They have no TAF and no MyID, so their reset is weaker.

text: A side app may reset a password with an SMS code from the bank's SMS service.
prefix: A side app may reset a password with an SMS code from the bank's SMS service.

text: But only for a customer with no master-app account, who was never at level two.
prefix: But only for a customer with no master-app account, who was never at level two.

text: Everyone else must reset in the mobile bank.
prefix: Everyone else must reset in the mobile bank.

text: The side-app reset is limited per day, then a cool-down follows.
prefix: The side-app reset is limited per day, then a cool-down follows.

text: And the waiting rule still applies when the customer has an active session.
prefix: And the waiting rule still applies when the customer has an active session.

text: Yes, a SIM swap is still a risk for a customer who uses only side apps.
prefix: Yes, a SIM swap is still a risk for a customer who uses only side apps.

text: The bank accepts that risk, on purpose, and writes it down.
prefix: The bank accepts that risk, on purpose, and writes it down.

text: Last, the trail.
prefix: Last, the trail.

text: Each step of each reset writes an audit event and an antifraud event, and sends a notification to every other session and by SMS.
prefix: Each step of each reset writes an audit event and an antifraud event, and sends a notification to every other session and by SMS.

text: Resets for each customer are counted, too.
prefix: Resets for each customer are counted, too.

text: And a bank operator can cancel or approve a waiting reset, always with a reason.
prefix: And a bank operator can cancel or approve a waiting reset, always with a reason.

text: To recap: the master-app reset runs the checks of a login, without the password.
prefix: To recap: the master-app reset runs the checks of a login, without the password.

text: An active session makes the reset wait, and only a rank-two session or an operator can cancel it.
prefix: An active session makes the reset wait, and only a rank-two session or an operator can cancel it.

text: Green TAF and MyID together make it immediate.
prefix: Green TAF and MyID together make it immediate.

text: And side apps reset by SMS only for customers the master app has never seen.
prefix: And side apps reset by SMS only for customers the master app has never seen.

text: But go back to the stranger with Aziz's SIM card.
prefix: But go back to the stranger with Aziz's SIM card.

text: He did not forget the password.
prefix: He did not forget the password.

text: He guessed it, and he tries a normal login on his new phone.
prefix: He guessed it, and he tries a normal login on his new phone.

text: Aziz's phone lights up: Approve, or This was not me.
prefix: Aziz's phone lights up: Approve, or This was not me.

text: What happens after he taps This was not me?
prefix: What happens after he taps This was not me?
